questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Iinyathi or Boland?
Nonkululeko Mlaba is the only South African woman to ever take a 10-wicket match haul in Test cricket. What were her match figures, against England in December 2024?
questions.explanation: Mlaba took 4 for 90 and 6 for 67 (10 for 157 in the match) against England at Bloemfontein in December 2024, the best match figures by a South African woman in Test history.

questions.question: At which ground did Khushi Mistry record their career-best innings (32, T20)?
